findings.summary: Configured append_space=true has no effect on consecutive final insertions.
findings.observed: Two agreed sentences inserted as adjacent period/uppercase letter, no separator; reproduced in both 3000ms and 5000ms native Windows trials.
findings.sourceCause: text_injector.TextInjectionQueue enqueues entry.text unchanged; _process_job writes job.text unchanged. append_space appears in config/settings metadata only; no runtime consumer.
findings.proposedScope: Honor existing preference solely in the queued injection text at the existing boundary; preserve authoritative history/final text and identities; include automatic and manual reinsertion and trailing-whitespace controls. Exact implementation after bundled scope approval and focused red regression.
findings.qualificationImpact: New source/product/build qualification in progress; previous 41ca761 evidence remains historical.
findings.implementation: Only local Clipboard payload gets one space when enabled and no existing trailing whitespace; authoritative text and IDs unchanged.
